Common SEO Problems We Identify

A website can remain invisible even when it looks professional. During an audit we commonly find:

  • important pages not indexed correctly
  • several pages targeting the same keyword
  • thin service or location content
  • weak Google Business Profile signals
  • slow mobile experience and heavy scripts
  • few relevant internal links
  • reports focused on activity instead of enquiries

The solution depends on the cause. Publishing more articles will not fix a blocked page, and technical corrections alone will not help content that fails to answer the query. We connect the findings in one prioritized roadmap.

For eligible businesses serving Indore, local SEO can improve how customers discover business information across search and Maps. On-Page, Content and Technical SEO

On-page work improves titles, headings, copy, image context and internal links. Content work fills genuine information gaps with service pages, FAQs, guides and comparisons. Technical SEO checks whether search engines can crawl, render and index the preferred version of each page.

Expected Results and Measurement

Rankings remain useful, but they are not viewed in isolation. A page attracting thousands of irrelevant visits can be less valuable than a focused page generating a smaller number of qualified enquiries. Reports therefore explain completed work and what the data suggests doing next.
